population: single hypothetical eligible game merchant, no actual seller records
unit: captured transactions and distinct full refunds/disputes then one eligible seller balance
double_count_guards: Refunded or charged-back orders are removed from retained gross once, and must not also be subtracted as a duplicate full-price fee.
Processing cost for all captured orders is deducted once, less explicitly credited amounts.
Actual platform reversal-retention fees are separately supplied if applicable; no automatic assumption they are retained.
Merchant payout and FX charges belong in the refund reconciler's merchantPayoutAndFxFeesCents, not another payment step.
Taxes withheld are separated from personal final tax liability; no universal withholding rate is applied.
Operator payout request eligibility is not operator approval, actual bank settlement, or guaranteed arrival date.
Zero/negative balance cannot meet the positive $5 collected payout minimum.
limitations: The $15 chargeback fee in the fixture is an explicit hypothetical assumption, not an observed provider fee.
The $1 withholding and $5 hold are synthetic, not actual reserves, account disputes, or tax law.
A single order-price case has no mixed product-price distribution, currency conversion or partial refunds.
Collected by itch.io merchants can face account adjustments even when the platform handles a payment dispute; this is not an empirical incident rate.
Real processor rules, individual seller tax forms, reserves, and eligibility differ by jurisdiction.
No credentials, payment provider accounts, merchant dashboard, real buyers, purchase orders or bank transfers were accessed.
